title: Lands of the Marches
changes: The war table now groups the territories into their lands, The Oakvale Lands and The Sunscar, with a dashed border, the land's name and the Waygate drawn between them.
The war table legend shows how much of each land every clan holds.
The front plaque names the land you are in and marks forward capitals: the clans whose homeland is not built yet hold them until it is.
